title: Self-Spec: Model-Authored Specifications for Reliable LLM Code Generation

contributions.purpose: 让模型自撰规范再据此生成代码以提升可靠性
contributions.mechanism: 确定性(T=0)六角色编排:SpecDesigner/Instantiator/FMInterviewer/SpecApplier/FMConfirmer/SpecExecutor,含 Q&A 确认环
contributions.evaluation: 免微调、模型无关(定性设计)
contributions.source_quote: We introduce SELF-SPEC, a lightweight, deterministic (T=0) orchestration that prompts a model to (i) design a compact spec schema it prefers... and (iv) generate code only from the confirmed spec.

contributions.purpose: 验证自撰规范对强模型的增益
contributions.mechanism: HumanEval pass@1(单样本 T=0)对比直连 NL→code
contributions.source_quote: On HumanEval (pass@1, single sample), SELF-SPEC improves over direct NL→code for stronger models: GPT-4o 87%→92% (+5) and Claude 3.7 92%→94% (+2); Claude 3.5 dips 90%→89% (−1).

contributions.purpose: 定位 Claude 3.5 退化根因
contributions.mechanism: 移除生成代码中过度防御的 raise/assert 守卫(未指定时改 no-op)
contributions.evaluation: Claude 3.5 由 89% 回到 90% 基线
contributions.source_quote: which returns to baseline once we remove over-defensive guards in generated code (e.g., replacing raise/assert with no-ops when unspecified).

self_declared_provenance.quote: If so, we obtain a middle path between direct NL→code and fixed human-designed IRs... For example, a verification-aware Dafny intermediate has been reported at ~77% pass@1 on HumanEval with pure Dafny, with a hybrid "Dafny+direct" fallback rising to ~88%.

notes: AI 署名红旗:第一作者直接署名"GPT-5"(OpenAI),AI 主导。负结果/trade-off:Claude 3.5 −1%(退化,需移守卫才回基线)。局限:单基准(仅 HumanEval)、仅 3 个闭源模型、pass@1 单样本无误差棒、增益小(+2~+5)。定位为替代 Dafny 类固定 IR 的中间路径。accept。
